subject: Your Abundance account has been locked
previewText: Please use your new password to log in to your Abundance account

fields.heading: Your account has been locked
fields.body:
Hello,

Your Abundance account has been locked for security reasons after a number of failed login attempts.

To unlock your account, please contact Abundance at support@abundanceinvestment.com or 020 3475 8666.
